senses.gloss: , contr. לִזְבֵּז, לִזְבֵּיז, לִיזְ׳ m. (לבז, cmp. לָבַד) [that which is joined to an object,] vertical rim, edge (by which a flat utensil is made into a vessel-like receptacle, v. פָֹּשוּט a. תָּוֶךְ).
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 48b:14">Pes. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>טבלה שאין לה לבזבז</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לבזבזין</he> pl.) a board which has no edges; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:3">Kel. II, 3</cite> <he>לזביז</he> (R. S. in some ed. <he>לביזבז</he>).
<cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 2:18">Tosef. Ukts. II, 18</cite> <he>טבלה שיש לה ליזביז</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. eth. <he>לבזבזין</he>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 12:5">Tosef. Ohol. XII, 5</cite> an inverted vessel (v. <cite ref="K01022"><he>כְּפִישָׁה</he></cite>) <he>ויש לה ליז׳ טפח</he> which has a rim of one handbreadth projecting from the bottom (so that it can be used as a receptacle in its inverted state).

<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 6:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VI, 17</cite> <he>יש לה הליזבז</he> (read <he>יש לה ל׳</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:9">Kel. VIII, 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02350"><he>אִסְטַגְיוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 4:2">Mikv. IV, 2</cite> <he>לבזבז</he> Mish. ed.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>לְבִזְבְּזִין</he>, <he>לִזְבֵּזִין</he>, <he>לִיזְ׳</he>. Pes. l. c., v. supra.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:1">Kel. XVIII, 1</cite> (ed. Dehr. <he>לִיזְבֵּיזִין</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 8:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 1</cite> <he>ליזביזין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="L00527"><he>לישביזין</he></cite>; oth. ed. <he>ליזבזין</he>).
